$note: Every design file in this handoff, in the order the brief lists its surfaces. kind=target: a window to build to. kind=sheet: parts and states on one page.

screens.shows: The footer under the map opened: every idle, resumable session, newest first, grouped by when. Shows a group pill, an Unfiled session and an archived one.
The same list with 312 sessions: it scrolls, grouped by week and then by month. Shows a title too long for its row, a session that is open in Terminal, and an Unfiled one.
The 16 ANSI colours, cursor and selection on the console background, the Increase Contrast set, and three samples.
Inside a project with nothing running. The console says so and offers the last session first.
A session whose process has exited. Its last output stays; a bar under it says what happened.
All projects with no Home session running: the Home pane says so and offers to start one.
Every message the console can show when there is no live terminal, on one sheet.
Two Claude sessions and two shells in one tab strip, a shell selected. Shell tabs carry a prompt mark, not a state glyph.
The chevron beside + opened: a new Claude session or a new shell.
The window at 1280×800 with six tabs. Those that don’t fit move into a menu; the selected tab always stays.
Tab kinds and states on one sheet: sessions and shells, promotion, a failed shell, overflow.
